# CLI reference

Generated from the argparse tree. Every command that produces data supports
`--json`, and machine output is pure ASCII so a legacy console cannot break it.

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` QC failed (the run finished and the dub did not pass),
`2` the command could not run.

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`dubforge doctor`](#dubforge-doctor) | what this machine can and cannot do |
| [`dubforge providers`](#dubforge-providers) | every adapter, its readiness and its honest quality note |
| [`dubforge voices`](#dubforge-voices) | list voices for a TTS provider |
| [`dubforge plan`](#dubforge-plan) | probe the file, resolve providers, estimate cost — no work done |
| [`dubforge dub`](#dubforge-dub) | dub the file |
| [`dubforge demo`](#dubforge-demo) | run the whole pipeline offline on a synthetic clip |
| [`dubforge srt`](#dubforge-srt) | write subtitles from a transcript dump |
| [`dubforge capabilities`](#dubforge-capabilities) | what this install can do, in JSON or prose |
| [`dubforge validate-config`](#dubforge-validate-config) | check a settings file and the environment |
| [`dubforge jobs`](#dubforge-jobs) | list, inspect, cancel, retry or clean up jobs |
| [`dubforge explain`](#dubforge-explain) | show what a finished job actually cost, stage by stage |
| [`dubforge review`](#dubforge-review) | export, validate or apply a human review file |
| [`dubforge cache`](#dubforge-cache) | inspect or clean the content caches |

## `dubforge mcp`

run the MCP server on stdio


## Typical sessions

One file, synchronously, with a QC gate:

```bash
dubforge plan lesson.mp4 --to hi            # cost and blockers first
dubforge dub lesson.mp4 --to hi --json | jq '.qc.failures'
```

A term's lessons, in the background, with a ledger:

```bash
dubforge batch lessons/ --to hi --estimate --workdir ./work
dubforge jobs list --status failed --workdir ./work
dubforge jobs retry <job-id> --workdir ./work
```

Diagnosing a machine:

```bash
dubforge doctor && dubforge capabilities && dubforge validate-config
```
